business_summary.text: Bodal Chemicals is an integrated chemical manufacturer with products in Basic Chemicals, Dye Intermediates, Dyestuffs, and Chlor Alkali segments. The company has a global presence with manufacturing facilities in India and subsidiaries in Turkey, China, and Indonesia.
